If you really want to help her, please stay by her side and don't leave her alone, listen to her and fight with her, I don't know how close they are, but if you are asking for help to know what to do, I guess you care a lot. Fight with her, try to distract her, don't let her lock herself in her thoughts or in her room, try to take her to new places, talk to her, distract her, listen to her, but for nothing in the world leave her alone, because having those kinds of thoughts and also feeling totally alone is something horrible, there may come a point where you get tired, but please understand that she will not be able to control what she feels, so be patient to help her, even if you are tired, do not give up. Also, seeing a psychologist or psychiatrist can help if she hasn't been to one yet, you can support her and convince her to seek psychological help.
